meta.title: my-calendar
meta.description: A personal calendar to manage events monthly, chat with AI about them, and get reminders

home.calendarPlaceholder: The monthly calendar will appear here.

login.signInDescription: Enter your details to check your schedule
login.signUpDescription: Get started with your email and a password
login.guestHint: Try it without signing up. Your events are kept in this browser and deleted after 30 days without a visit.
login.checkEmail: We sent a confirmation email. Open the link in it to finish signing up. If you don't see it, check your spam folder.
login.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with both letters and numbers.
login.resendSent: We sent the confirmation email again. Please check your inbox and spam folder.

nav.guestSignOutDescription: If you sign out, the events and AI chats you made as a guest are deleted right away and can't be recovered.

ai.disclaimer: AI answers can be wrong. Events are only added, changed or deleted when you press the button on the card. Depending on your question, event titles and descriptions are sent to Google Gemini, and chats are stored for 30 days after the last message.
